skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Select a legal issue relevant to the internship organization and conduct independent research.
Analyze legal regulations and their practical application within the internship organization.
Propose solutions to legal issues and improve legal application within the organization.
Effectively communicate and present research findings.
Evaluate legal theories and practical implementation, and provide recommendations for legal improvement.
Manage time effectively to complete research and reporting tasks.
Adhere to professional ethics and responsibilities.
Work effectively in a team and collaborate with mentors and internship supervisors.
Produce well-structured and formatted research reports.
Write clear and logical legal documents and reports.
Analyze data and draw meaningful conclusions related to legal issues.
Understand and comply with legal regulations and organizational policies.
